facts.fact: Egyptian start-up Fincart raised a US$2.8 million seed round co-led by Launch Africa (a pan-African venture capital fund) and Antler MENAP, with Yango Ventures, Five35 Ventures, Bluestream Capital, Hi2 Global and Kalahari Venture Labs; the document gives no signing date, so the published date (2026-07-28) is used, and does not state where the financiers are from.
